name: Save the Cat Beatsheet
description: Precise beatsheet with fifteen stations for a clearly guided story arc.

acts.title: Act 1: Setup
acts.description: Starting world, topic and decision to leave.

beats.title: Opening image
beats.description: A concentrated image conveys tone and initial state.
guidingQuestions: Which picture summarizes the initial situation?
What contrast should the final image form?

beats.title: Theme is hinted at
beats.description: A question or statement indicates the necessary knowledge.
guidingQuestions: What truth does the main character have to learn?
Who pronounces them?

beats.title: Set up
beats.description: Everyday life, relationships, shortcomings and goals are established.
guidingQuestions: What isn't working in the character's life?
Which elements must return later?

beats.title: trigger
guidingQuestions: What cannot be undone?
Why does it affect this character in particular?

beats.title: Doubt
beats.description: The main character struggles with the risk and consequences of departure.
guidingQuestions: What legitimate fear exists?
What makes doing nothing impossible?

beats.title: Transition to Act 2
beats.description: An active decision leads to a new world of action.
guidingQuestions: What choice does the character make?
How does the direction of the story change?

acts.title: Act 2: Confrontation
acts.description: Promise, subplot, reversal and increasing pressure.

beats.title: Subplot
beats.description: A second relationship or action reflects the theme.
guidingQuestions: Who shows a different view on the topic?
How does this affect the main conflict?

beats.title: fun and games
beats.description: The central promise of the story unfolds in successes and problems.
guidingQuestions: Which expectations of the genre are fulfilled?
What does the character learn through action?

beats.title: Center point
beats.description: An apparent win or loss increases stakes and time pressure.
guidingQuestions: What changes the meaning of the goal?
How does the stakes increase?

beats.title: The net is closing
beats.description: External opponents and internal mistakes narrow the possibilities.
guidingQuestions: Which forces are gaining ground?
What internal flaw is making the situation worse?

beats.title: Everything is lost
beats.description: A serious loss destroys the previous plan.
guidingQuestions: What is visibly lost?
Why is the old strategy failing?

beats.title: Dark night of the soul
beats.description: The character deals with the rock bottom and finds a new truth.
guidingQuestions: What truth is finally accepted?
What gives new courage?

beats.title: Transition to Act 3
beats.description: The main and subplots combine to form a new plan.
guidingQuestions: What insights are combined?
Why can the new plan work?

acts.title: Act 3: Finale
acts.description: The new plan is implemented and the issue is proven.

beats.title: final
beats.description: The character overcomes resistance through his completed development.
guidingQuestions: How does the finale test the new stance?
What order emerges?

beats.title: Final picture
beats.description: A final picture shows the change compared to the beginning.
guidingQuestions: What is visibly different?
What emotional note remains?
